summary: Claimed 80% off, but the market reference is also ₹799. The M.R.P. is 5.0x the price stores actually charge.

voices.point: Users often praise clear bass and sound quality.
Many say the earbuds feel good, classy, and easy to carry.
Several reviews mention the earbuds working properly and feeling worth the price.
Some Amazon reviewers report one earbud stopping, Bluetooth pairing issues, and mixed battery life.
